notes.title: Patch #2
notes.notes:
Hello!
We focused on:

- loading window not loading a save file when clicked
- fixed a bug where the game would crash when using an empty slot for a new game.
- fixing minor hidden errors within the game

If you encounter any bugs please do inform us!

-AM

notes.title: Bug fixes and new features
notes.notes:
Hello! 
Thank you for your reviews and bug reports!
The game now has a brightness slider that you can edit on launch and from the menu

We got the written text that comes up with the collectible journals and we fixed various bugs that got reported after launch from UI glitches to core gameplay bugs.

Have a wonderful time! 

-AM
